inverse-function.label: Recovered command x
inverse-function.description: An inverse function reverses a one-to-one rule by exchanging its inputs and outputs. For an affine calibration, subtract the offset and divide by the nonzero gain. The inverse is a function, rather than the reciprocal of a function value.

geometric-series.label: Total signed displacement
geometric-series.description: A geometric series adds terms with one common ratio. A partial sum adds a finite whole number of terms. Its closed form has a separate r=1 case. With a nonzero first term, the infinite geometric series has a finite sum exactly when the ratio has magnitude less than one.
